sentences.text: Shri Mukesh Agrawal, Advocate for the pet  Shri Tapan Bathre, Panel Lawyer for the r Counsel for the petitioner submits that inspection o f his godown and shops was carried on 16/12/2020 by inspection team constituted by the Collector-Cum-District Magistrate, District Chhatarpur.
After inspection, his godowns and shop were sealed.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that action is without power and jurisdiction.

It is submitted that as per Section 10(4) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 the Inspector has the power to seize and carry away or keep in safe custody of the vendor but cannot seal the godown or shop of the petitioner.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it is ordered that godowns and shop o f the petitioner may b e unsealed but the authority is free to take any action to seize the food items and adulterants or any other material used by the shopkeeper.
Counsel for the respondent prays for some time to file reply.
Notice be issued to the respondents on payment of P.F. within seven days.
(NANDITA DUBEY) JUDGE sjk Shailesh Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 July, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86963918/
